name: mercari_shops_jp-mcp
description: Mercari Shops (JP) (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, end_listing, set_inventory, list_orders

platform_mcp_mercari_shops_jp_access_tok.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MERCARI_SHOPS_JP_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_mercari_shops_jp_access_tok.description: Personal API Access Token issued on your mercari Shops shop administration page; sent as Authorization: Bearer.

platform_mcp_mercari_shops_jp_user_agent.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MERCARI_SHOPS_JP_USER_AGENT
platform_mcp_mercari_shops_jp_user_agent.description: User-Agent required by mercari Shops: <API_CLIENT_NAME>/<VERSION>, where API_CLIENT_NAME is the value Mercari assigns to your company at contract (e.g. EXAMPLE_SHOP/1.0.0); requests without the correct User-Agent are restricted.

tools.name: me
tools.description: query shop returns the shop you own (data.shop {id, name, shopStatus, businessKind}).

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: updateProduct(input: {id, name, description, price}) edits a LIVE product; only the fields sent change. price is an integer in yen between 300 and 9999999; name at most 130 characters, description 3000. Stock is per variant: use set_inventory. `status` is the product visibility (OPENED|UNOPENED).

tools.name: end_listing
tools.description: updateProduct(input: {id, status: UNOPENED}) makes the product private (非公開); reversible with status OPENED. The product is not deleted.

tools.name: set_inventory
tools.description: updateProductVariant(by: {skuCode} or {id}, input: {stockQuantity}) sets the stock of one VARIANT: pass `sku` (the variant skuCode) or `listing_id` as the variant id — not the product id.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: orderTransactions(first, orderedDateGte, statuses) — status: WAITING_FOR_PAYMENT|WAITING_FOR_SHIPPING|COMPLETING|COMPLETED|CANCELING|CANCELED; since is an ISO-8601 DateTime. totalPrice is integer yen including sales fee and shipping. Pagination is by cursor (pageInfo.endCursor in raw), so only the first page is reachable here.
